summary: Competitor teardown for Craze & Crash (Ravate, Bagholder Association, plus re-checks of Rise Fall Repeat and Company Man). Added 3 sourced Short topics (Lexus's 450 prototypes, Krispy Kreme quitting McDonald's, Angry Birds sold for less than its B listing) and one long-video title proposal.
why: The core Short format had no usable topic (Spanx and Yahoo wait on recent categories); Lexus is now the top usable topic (7.86). Bagholder's verdict titles have a 464,541 median over 9 films against 28,440 for its other 51. Our Shorts have no stayed-to-watch data yet.

findings.title: Bagholder's verdict titles: 16x its other titles
findings.detail: 9 'X Is (Finally) Getting What They Deserve...' films, median 464,541 views, against 28,440 for its other 51 on similar brands. Proposed as a long-video title test in our own words.

findings.title: Rise Fall Repeat's long Shorts didn't win on length
findings.detail: Its Shorts 120-200 days old got about 1,100-1,300 views at any length; only the last 90 days grew. The length challenger's evidence is corrected; Ravate gives weak support (60-100 s ahead in 2 of 3 age windows).

findings.title: Lexus: 450 prototypes, a 1984 start, 5,000 at launch
findings.detail: Toyota's own history plus Jalopnik and Motoring Research. Reference 511K on 19.9K.

findings.title: Krispy Kreme left McDonald's after reaching about 2,400 of 13,500 stores
findings.detail: Its own 8-K, June 2025: costs couldn't be brought in line with demand. Reference 734K on 10.8K.

changes.title: 3 Short topics in the feed
changes.detail: research/topics.json: Lexus (founder_bet, 7.86), Krispy Kreme (6.92), Angry Birds (6.16). 11 open, 8 usable.

changes.detail: cycle/backlog.json doc-short-length-50: the Rise Fall Repeat split was a time effect.
